3 free low-poly toy-style rigged animals (a cat, a fox and an owl) with 12 animations each and mouths that open, as GLB and FBX, ready for Unity, Godot, Unreal and three.js. They are CC0, so you can use them in commercial projects with no credit needed.

Like these? The full pack has 70 rigged animals (99 files with colourways), 13 animations and 9 rideable mounts → see the full pack. The free ones stay CC0 forever.

At a glance

What it is: I made this as three free low-poly rigged 3D animals, CC0: a cat, a fox and an owl, in a toy style with glossy eyes and a mouth that really opens.

Formats: GLB and FBX (with a full mesh and a mobile LOD in every file), for Unity, Godot, Unreal Engine and three.js (and Blender).

License: CC0 (public domain): commercial use is fine and no credit is needed.

How many: 3 animals with 12 animations each: idle, idle_alt, walk, run (fly on the owl), jump, eat, sit, sleep, attack, call, hit and death.

Full pack: If you want more, the full pack is Cute Pets & Wildlife: 70 rigged animals in 99 files, 13 animations, 9 rideable mounts and 15 perch + 15 shoulder companions.

These are three animals from my bigger Cute Pets & Wildlife pack (v3.1): a cat, a fox and an owl. They are free for anything, public domain (CC0), no credit needed. Each one is a rigged, animated toy animal with big glossy eyes and a mouth that really opens, so you can see the whole style in your own project before you decide on more.

The cat attacks, the fox calls and the owl calls: three of the 12 clips every animal has, all in place.

The faces are my favourite part. The eyes blink, and the mouth opens in call, attack and eat. That is a lower jaw on a Jaw bone, so the owl opens its beak too.

Inside

3 rigged, animated toy animals: cat, fox (19-bone skeleton) and owl (13-bone bird skeleton), 12 clips each: idle, idle_alt, walk, run (owl: fly), jump, eat, sit, sleep, attack, call, hit, death (30 fps, in place), with opening mouths and blinking eyes
Full mesh (LOD0) + mobile LOD (LOD1) in every file
GLB (web, Godot, Unreal, Blender) + FBX (Unity, Unreal, Maya), 2048 px painted albedo + ORM textures embedded and as PNG
1 unit = 1 m, one material per animal

v3.0 (free update): the pack got a complete "Designer Toy" remake: smooth toy shapes, glossy painted eyes, opening mouths and a mobile LOD in every file.

v3.1 (free update): animation fixes. Paws stay on the ground in the standing clips, walk and run are new in-place cycles, and parts no longer pass through each other.

Want more?

If you like them, I would love to see you in the full pack: Cute Pets & Wildlife - 70 Rigged Animals + 9 Rideable Mounts. It has 70 rigged animals in 99 files (pets, farm, forest, arctic, jungle & savanna, dinosaurs and fantasy), 13 animations, 9 rideable mounts and 15 perch + 15 shoulder companions. It is what keeps me making these, and the free sample stays free either way. The pack is also part of the Vuena All-in-1 (every pack plus all future packs).

	This free sample	Full pack
Animals	3 (cat, fox, owl)	70 species in 99 files
Animations	12 per animal	13 per animal
Bonus	-	9 rideable mounts, 15 perch + 15 shoulder companions
License	CC0	Royalty-free commercial licence
Good to know
The lights, the floor and the backdrop in the pictures and GIFs on this page are not in the files. I rendered them in Blender with lights I added.
The clips are procedural and in place (no root motion), made for games and dioramas, not motion-capture quality. The owl fly is an in-place hover.
Mouths open and eyes blink, but there is no other facial animation.
The species picture and the 12 clips picture show animals of the full pack as well; this sample has only the cat, the fox and the owl.

Made by our own procedural Blender scripts; no AI-generated meshes or textures. License: CC0 1.0 for this sample only.

1 Nov 2026: new banner, GIFs and pictures on this page. The files did not change.
